newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTIKO Q1 NET PROFIT 2.257 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTIKO Q1 NET PROFIT 2.257 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estiko made a consolidated net profit of 2.257 million kroons and had turnover of 53.8 million kroons in the first quarter, the company said on Friday.
Estiko's operating profit was 3.5 million kroons, it added in a statement.
"Estiko group financial activity has been in line with our estimates," the company said.
The company did not give any comparative figures for the first quarter of 1996 as it said that at that time the results were not consolidated.
Consolidated assets reached 102.6 million kroons in the first quarter, up from 90.7 million kroons at the start of 1997.
Estiko consolidated net profit in 1996 was 7.15 million kroons and turnover 219 million kroons.
Estiko estimates its turnover to be 265 million kroons and net profit at 8.5 million kroons this year.
